# mikeu.gis — Riki Ruswandi

> Portfolio and technical blog of Riki Ruswandi (Mikeu), a software engineer focused on GIS: WebGIS applications, spatial data and map-based systems for local governments and companies, plus the APIs, automation and deployment around them. Based in Purwakarta, West Java, Indonesia.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/): Map-style landing page: profile, featured project "layers", capabilities, career route, latest articles and contact.
- [Projects](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/projects): Portfolio of WebGIS, geospatial and information-system projects, mostly for Purwakarta Regency agencies.
- [Blog](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/blog): Articles on WebGIS, spatial data, web development and AI.
- [About](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/about): Background, tech stack and career journey.
- [Footprints (Jejak)](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/world): Hex-grid world map (Equal Earth projection) of where site visitors come from.
- [Contact](https://www.mikeudev.my.id/contact): Contact form for project inquiries.

## Focus areas

- WebGIS with Leaflet and OpenLayers; spatial data and map-based dashboards
- Geospatial information systems for local government (e.g. Satu Peta Purwakarta)
- Web applications and APIs with Laravel, CodeIgniter 4 and SvelteKit
- Automation and deployment

## Languages

Indonesian (default, https://www.mikeudev.my.id/) and English (https://www.mikeudev.my.id/en).
